title: Mid-Day Deep Sea Fishing in Myrtle Beach
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Set sail on a 5-hour fishing adventure aboard a spacious vessel equipped with two decks and a full-service galley. This mid-day fishing trip is ideal for all ages, offering a chance to catch various fish species such as black sea bass, flounder, and small sharks. With all necessary equipment, bait, and licenses included, you'll just need to bring your snacks and drinks (no glass, please). Enjoy a comfortable ride as the experienced crew guides you to the best fishing spots, making it perfect for both novice and seasoned anglers. Join us for a fun day on the water. 

- 5-hour fishing experience suitable for all ages
- All fishing gear and licenses are provided
- Full-service galley with snacks and drinks available for purchase
- Kids aged 2 and under can join for free, with discounted rates for ages 3-12
